items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Well, Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly, Walter Blue, Cuckoo.

ctx.x: And all you know is Red? Yes, sir. I saw that. He's a Red. Red. I always call Red. It's sharp. Did you get his favorites, Phil? No. I think we copied that card all right. Okay. I hate to put you on the spot, but... Not all of them. Some of them. Black Ben A. What about favorite trumpet players? Did he talk about who your Rambam's trumpet player would be?
Well, Buddy Petit and Chris Kelly, Walter Blue, Cuckoo.
